shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: The Method of Langar.
Soratha.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਧਰਮ ਜੋ ਸਾਰ ਨੰਦ ਲਾਲ ਤੁਮ ਸੁ ਕਹਾ॥
verses.translit_en: rahat dharam jo saar na(n)dh laal tum su kahaa||

en.bdb: Nand Lal, I have related to you the Rehit, which is the quintessence of Dharam.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੰਗਰ ਕਉ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਤੁਮ ਆਗੇ ਬਰਨਨ ਕਰੋਂ॥੧੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: la(n)gar kau parakaar tum aage baranan karo(n)||110||

en.bdb: Now I shall describe before you the manner of preparing Langar.
Listen O' brother! to the mode of preparing langar.
Nand Lal, listen as I tell you.
First, purify the ground;
Be sure to cast away all filth and impurities.
Next, mark out the cooking square there;
Raise boundaries on all four sides.
Place a vessel of clean water there;
Also procure a new water pot.
Scour and wash all utensils;
Then proceed to cook the langar.
Bring forth dry clean wood;
Strike a flint and start a good fire.
Any dirty, impure, and contaminated material that comes your way;
Be sure to keep it away.
Bring Ghee, sweets, and uncooked food items:
Bring forth squash, turnips,
lentils, pulse, and such produce.
Bring items such as  black grain and pounded pulse.
Spinach and mustard greens;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਭੀ ਲੰਗਰ ਮੈਂ ਗਹੈ॥੧੧੯
verses.translit_en: tin ko bhee la(n)gar mai(n) gahai||119

en.bdb: Bring these in the langar as well.
Add items like sweet peppers as one's heart desires;
Add salt according to taste.
Curds, rice and all sorts of pickles.
Prepare and place all such items for eating.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਣ ਭਰ ਰਸਦ ਜੇ ਲੰਗਰ ਜਾਨੈ॥
verses.translit_en: man bhar rasadh je la(n)gar jaanai||

en.bdb: If the langar can supply a full mound of grain;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਵਾ ਦੁਇ ਸੇਰ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਿਹ ਆਨੈ॥੧੨੨॥
verses.translit_en: savaa dhui ser ghirat teh aanai||122||

en.bdb: Add to it two and a quarter seers of ghee.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜ਼ਾਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੁ ਨੀਕੋ॥
verses.translit_en: zaadhaa hoi su bahutu su neeko||

en.bdb: If there is more so much the better;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁੱਖ ਹੋਤ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਕੋ॥੧੨੩॥
verses.translit_en: su'kh hot dhiaan ke jee ko||123||

en.bdb: Take into consideration how long it will last.
Do it to the best of your ability;

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਧਰੇ॥੧੨੪॥
verses.translit_en: man mai kachhoo na chi(n)taa dhare||124||

en.bdb: Hold no worries in your heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਯਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਦੇਗ ਸੁਹਾਈ॥
verses.translit_en: yeh gur kee hai dheg suhaiee||

en.bdb: This is the Guru's glorious Degh.
One who prepares it with love will reap its benefit.
The wise Singh who's adherent to the Rehit;
He will know every technique of preparing food.
The compassionate one who knows this method;
He will completely comprehend the Maryada of Langar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਨ ਮਨ ਮੋ ਕਰਈ॥
verses.translit_en: raag dhavaikh na man mo kariee||

en.bdb: Such a person should have no attachment or desire in his heart.
He should serve everyone equally.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਸੁਸ਼ੀਲ ਧੀਰ ਮਨ ਜਿਨ ਕੋ॥
verses.translit_en: param susheel dheer man jin ko||

en.bdb: One who is most well-mannered, and has much patience in his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨ ਲੋਭ ਨ ਮਨ ਮੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ॥੧੨੯॥
verses.translit_en: bhojan lobh na man mo tin ko||129||

en.bdb: One who has no greed over food within his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਹਿਤ ਲੋਭ ਨ ਧਰੈ॥
verses.translit_en: sut kalatr hit lobh na dharai||

en.bdb: One who has no attachment to his children and wife within.
One who always rises in the early hours of the day and bathes;
Have only him prepare and distribute langar.
Let no one else enter the premise.
One who never goes near the cannabis plant and Tobacco;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਭੀ ਸੁਚਿ ਦੇਗ ਕਰਾਵੈ॥੧੩੨॥
verses.translit_en: tin te bhee such dheg karaavai||132||

en.bdb: Have such an individual prepare the Langar.
If one is to be recognized as a Singh who is obedient to the Rehit;
He shall hold no greed in his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਸਬਨ ਮੈਂ ਦੇਖੈ॥
verses.translit_en: guroo kaa roop saban mai(n) dhekhai||

en.bdb: He sees the Guru's image in all;
Never does he consume wine and meat.
Whenever Degh (Langar; Prashad) has been prepared;
Perform Ardaas and sanctify it with a knife.
